objective: Complete the desktop dashboard page migration by moving Avatar Stage and Runtime & Safety markup out of legacy App.vue into dedicated typed Vue components while preserving App.vue/Electron main ownership of avatar, widget and Safety IPC/lifecycle.
non_goals: Do not change the VRM/Live2D renderer, avatar state machine, widget persistence/drag behavior, Safety controls, control-plane retry/backoff, event polling or typed IPC contracts.

Do not add a dependency, direct renderer Electron/network/storage/process access, new avatar asset, new model, widget background listener, or real desktop/widget/avatar smoke against the owner's active session.
Do not alter the existing safety policy, mute/emergency behavior, or widget visibility semantics.
contracts: AvatarPage and RuntimePage are typed presentation only. They receive bounded status/telemetry and emit fixed owner intent; they do not import Electron, Node, direct network APIs, persistence, process access or model runtimes.
App.vue remains the sole owner of typed avatar/widget/Safety IPC, polling, control-plane retry/backoff, stage events, widget position lifecycle, VRM lazy-load/recovery and error logging.
The pages never receive raw IPC, OS window handles, stored widget-position records, secret/tokens, unbounded runtime logs or arbitrary commands.
Avatar manual cues, widget show/hide/reset, mute and emergency controls retain their exact pre-existing fixed action set and Safety checks.
Desktop security tests include both extracted pages and demonstrate no direct renderer capability or legacy root dashboard markup remains.
allowed_dependencies: Existing Vue 3/TypeScript, current Electron typed IPC and repository test tooling; no new dependency.
acceptance_criteria: All Avatar Stage and Runtime & Safety dashboard markup is removed from App.vue and rendered through pages/AvatarPage.vue and pages/RuntimePage.vue.
The extracted pages preserve current status, manual avatar preview, widget controls, mute/emergency controls and operator guidance through typed props/emits only.
Dashboard module documentation records every current desktop page as migrated out of App.vue.
Desktop typecheck, desktop security/build test and the repository fast gate pass without generated test artifacts retained.
